text: Caution should be exercised to prevent inadvertent overdose [see USE IN SPECIFIC POPULATIONS (8.5),(8.6)]. Precipitation of acyclovir in renal tubules may occur when the solubility (2.5 mg/mL) is exceeded in the intratubular fluid. In the event of acute renal failure and anuria, the patient may benefit from hemodialysis until renal function is restored [see DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION (2.4)].
